### Research & Engineering Work

Take a slow, expert-dependent process in healthcare and see if a model can do the first pass faster. Three tracks below; the numbers are the ones I'd defend in an interview.

#### A · Medical Imaging & Computational Pathology

<table>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="33%">

**StrokeSeg-xAI**

Explainable ischemic stroke lesion segmentation on ISLES 2018 CTP maps, built for small, low-contrast lesions.

**Oral @ NBRCOM, AIIMS Jodhpur**, manuscript under review

![ISLES 2018](https://img.shields.io/badge/ISLES_2018-E07BA8?style=flat-square) ![Generalized Dice + Focal Tversky](https://img.shields.io/badge/Generalized_Dice_%2B_Focal_Tversky-6B4C9A?style=flat-square) ![Grad-CAM](https://img.shields.io/badge/Grad--CAM-6B4C9A?style=flat-square) ![MC-Dropout](https://img.shields.io/badge/MC--Dropout-6B4C9A?style=flat-square)

<sub>Prof. Anup Singh · </sub>

</td>
<td valign="top" width="34%">

**Lightweight H&E → Spatial Gene Expression**

Predicting spatial gene expression from H&E slides with models small enough to deploy.

**0.463 vs 0.435** cell-wise PCC for TinyGPQ (~315k params) with DeepSpot-M distilled into it. Reproduced TinyH2GNet on HEST-1k HER2 at 0.462 vs the paper's 0.463: a 38× smaller model loses only ~0.04 PCC. Replicating HINGE (CVPR 2026) with the CellFM foundation model.

![HEST-1k](https://img.shields.io/badge/HEST--1k-E07BA8?style=flat-square) ![TinyH2GNet](https://img.shields.io/badge/TinyH2GNet-6B4C9A?style=flat-square) ![TinyGPQ](https://img.shields.io/badge/TinyGPQ-6B4C9A?style=flat-square) ![DeepSpot-M](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSpot--M-6B4C9A?style=flat-square) ![HINGE](https://img.shields.io/badge/HINGE-6B4C9A?style=flat-square) ![CellFM](https://img.shields.io/badge/CellFM-6B4C9A?style=flat-square)

<sub>IIT Delhi, Prof. Ishaan Gupta · Code: [BTP](https://github.com/Shivanshu9799/BTP)</sub>

</td>
<td valign="top" width="33%">

**Thermal-imaging AI for Pressure Injury** (UNSW Sydney)

PRISMA-ScR review across 77 screened records, with Mask R-CNN / CapsNet / ConvNeXt benchmarked for staging.

**92–95% staging accuracy, AUC up to 0.98**, and 3 systematic gaps in the literature

![PRISMA-ScR](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRISMA--ScR-E07BA8?style=flat-square) ![Mask R-CNN](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mask_R--CNN-6B4C9A?style=flat-square) ![CapsNet](https://img.shields.io/badge/CapsNet-6B4C9A?style=flat-square) ![ConvNeXt](https://img.shields.io/badge/ConvNeXt-6B4C9A?style=flat-square)

</tr>

#### B · Document AI & Healthcare Systems

<table>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="50%">

**Rasyn AI: Healthcare Document Layout** (Aug–Sep 2026)

Synthetic-data pipeline with pseudo-labels from PP-DocLayout / DocLayout-YOLO and a self-hosted Qwen2.5-VL. **DocGrammar**: declarative per-document schemas that derive reading-order ground truth, plus an XY-Cut difficulty controller. A geometry-aware layout metric. SFT of DocLayout-v3.

![PP-DocLayout](https://img.shields.io/badge/PP--DocLayout-6B4C9A?style=flat-square) ![DocLayout-YOLO](https://img.shields.io/badge/DocLayout--YOLO-6B4C9A?style=flat-square) ![Qwen2.5-VL](https://img.shields.io/badge/Qwen2.5--VL-6B4C9A?style=flat-square) ![DocLayout-v3](https://img.shields.io/badge/DocLayout--v3-6B4C9A?style=flat-square)

<sub>Proprietary, so described here and not linked</sub>

</td>
<td valign="top" width="50%">

**Vagus Labs**

AI clinical scribe with a context layer that maps dialect-level symptoms to **SNOMED CT** (multilingual embeddings, graph-based concept expansion, schema-constrained generation). ABDM/ABHA integration, **FHIR R4** bundles, and a doctor dashboard where one-click corrections feed back into the dialect lexicon.

![SNOMED CT](https://img.shields.io/badge/SNOMED_CT-E07BA8?style=flat-square) ![FHIR R4](https://img.shields.io/badge/FHIR_R4-E07BA8?style=flat-square) ![ABDM/ABHA](https://img.shields.io/badge/ABDM%2FABHA-E07BA8?style=flat-square)

<sub>Private · in development</sub>

</td>
</tr>
</table>
